name: MM-MTBench
intro: MM-MT-Bench是一个多轮LLM-as-a-judge评估基准，类似于文本MT-Bench，用于测试多模态指令调优模型。现有基准测试（如MMMU、MathVista、ChartQA等）侧重于封闭式问题和简短回答，无法评估模型在多轮对话中遵循用户指令和零样本回答开放式问题的能力。MM-MT-Bench旨在克服这一限制。
task_type: 开放式问答, 多轮对话
intro_en: MM-MT-Bench is a multi-turn LLM-as-a-judge evaluation benchmark, similar to the text-based MT-Bench, designed to test multimodal instruction-tuned models. Existing benchmarks (such as MMMU, MathVista, ChartQA, etc.) focus on closed-ended questions and short answers, and cannot assess a model's ability to follow user instructions and provide zero-shot answers to open-ended questions in multi-turn dialogues. MM-MT-Bench aims to overcome this limitation.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[选择实际用例] --> B{图像类别选择}
    B -- 图表 --> C(21个对话)
    B -- 表格 --> D(19个对话)
    B -- 流程图 --> E(24个对话)
    B -- 图示 --> F(20个对话)
    B -- 其他 --> G(8个对话)
    C & D & E & F & G --> H[总计92个对话]
    H --> I{对话轮次分类}
    I -- 单轮 --> J(66个对话)
    I -- 2轮 --> K(18个对话)
    I -- 3轮 --> L(4个对话)
    I -- 4轮 --> M(1个对话)
    J & K & L & M --> N[构建对话数据集]
    N --> O[模型并行查询]
    O --> P(提供历史参考答案)
    P --> Q[独立评分每个轮次]
    Q --> R{评判标准}
    R -- 正确性 --> S(信息提取是否正确)
    R -- 完整性 --> T(是否回答所有问题)
    S & T --> U[评判员1-10分评分]
    U --> V[生成MM-MT-Bench数据集]
    V --> W[Evaluation方法学]
    W --> X(与LMSys-Vision ELO排名相关性)
    X --> Y[0.91 Pearson相关系数]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect multimodal prompts that combine images or documents with user text"] --> B["Package 92 benchmark rows in the MM-MT-Bench dataset"]
    B --> C["Represent each item as a multi-turn chat-style interaction"]
    C --> D["Provide reference answers for judging open-ended multimodal responses"]
    D --> E["Run instruction-tuned multimodal models zero-shot to produce answers"]
    E --> F["Use the Mistral evaluation harness with GPT-4o as an LLM judge"]
    F --> G["Aggregate judge outputs across examples and turns"]
    G --> H["Report the final MM-MT-Bench score for multimodal dialogue instruction following"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集结合图像或文档与文本问题的多模态提示"] --> B["将样本打包为92行MM-MT-Bench数据集"]
    B --> C["把每个样本表示为多轮聊天式交互"]
    C --> D["提供参考答案用于评审开放式多模态回复"]
    D --> E["让多模态指令调优模型以零样本方式生成答案"]
    E --> F["使用Mistral评测框架并以GPT-4o作为LLM评审"]
    F --> G["跨样本和轮次汇总judge输出"]
    G --> H["报告多模态对话指令遵循的MM-MT-Bench得分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Mistral AI MM-MT-Bench Hugging Face dataset and mistral-evals repository, with the Pixtral 12B paper as the linked release paper. The dataset has 92 rows for multi-turn multimodal instruction-tuned model evaluation, includes image/text chat-style prompts and reference answers, and the Mistral eval harness identifies mm_mt_bench as an LLM-as-a-judge task that uses GPT-4o to judge model answers against reference answers.
